hypothesis: A high first-release aggregate nonfinancial-corporate net payout yield, defined relative only to the prior point-in-time expanding median, identifies frozen V11 U.S.-equity de-risk events that are too early and improves risk-adjusted performance versus both frozen V11 and an availability-matched unconditional retention control.
allowed_changes: F-NET-PAYOUT-YIELD-US = latest first-release NetPayoutYield >= median of all earlier point-in-time-available first-release NetPayoutYield observations
NetPayoutYield = (NetDividends - NetEquityIssuance) / EquityMarketValue using same-release Federal Reserve Z.1 tables
on factor-available frozen V11 U.S.-equity de-risk events, retain exactly 50% of nasdaq/sp500 reductions when risk-on
selection_metric: No within-family selection. Evaluate the single candidate against frozen V11 and C-NET-PAYOUT-ALWAYS, then apply every preregistered deterministic, bootstrap, and cumulative DSR gate.
pass_fail_gates: deterministic: at least 5/7 fixed folds candidate Sharpe >= matched-control Sharpe
deterministic: gross <=100%, min target weight >=0, no financing or negative cash
bootstrap: paired circular moving blocks, 63 sessions, 20000 replicates, seed 20260822
PBO: not applicable because the family contains exactly one candidate
global post-protocol DSR probability >=95% using all prior 29 formal return-seeking candidates plus F-NET-PAYOUT-YIELD-US, total trial count 30
ROBUST_FACTOR_PASS requires every applicable deterministic, bootstrap, and global DSR gate
follow_up_policy: This Net Payout Yield campaign contains exactly one retrospective candidate. After formal performance is viewed, do not search fixed payout thresholds, rolling medians/percentiles, q/q or y/y changes, z-scores, slopes, dividend-only/repurchase-only/issuance-only variants, alternative denominators, normalization variables, sign reversals, retention fractions, or a second retrospective Net Payout family. A promising non-robust result may only become a separately preregistered prospective shadow without changing this historical rule.
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_net_payout_yield_v1.py -> tools/net_payout_yield_v1.swiftpart + tools/net_payout_yield_v1_logic.swift -> frozen V11 source run + BacktestEngine.runResearchTargetProviderStrategyWithTrace -> shared BacktestDailySimulator
expected_outputs: V11-CONTROL metrics and frozen target fingerprint
all seven fixed fold metrics plus 2020+ and 2022+ slices
source/U.S.-de-risk/available/retained event counts and portfolio constraints
factor-library publish + remote readback if and only if ROBUST_FACTOR_PASS=true
run authorization receipt, execution Git commit and SHA-256 result artifact manifest

factor_definition.source: Federal Reserve Financial Accounts Z.1 original quarterly release archives
factor_definition.risk_on_rule: latest available yield >= prior-only expanding median, excluding the latest observation from the median

matched_control.rule: retain exactly 50% of nasdaq/sp500 reductions on every factor-available frozen V11 U.S.-de-risk event regardless of the payout-yield state

shared_rules.event_scope: unique execution dates on which frozen V11 report.trades is non-empty
shared_rules.eligible_event: current frozen V11 event reduces nasdaq and/or sp500 versus the prior frozen V11 event target

forbidden_changes: any frozen V11 parameter or target-path change
any rolling-window median/percentile or full-sample threshold
any q/q, y/y, z-score, rank, slope or acceleration transformation
any dividend-only, repurchase-only, issuance-only, total-payout or earnings-yield rescue
any CPI, GDP, market-cap, interest-rate or balance-sheet normalization
factor-driven trades between frozen V11 event dates
candidate replacement or a second retrospective Net Payout factor after results
dropping failed prior formal candidates from cumulative DSR accounting

factor_library_promotion.action: export -> validate -> import -> complete -> remote readback
factor_library_promotion.failed_or_near_miss_policy: retain as research evidence; do not label validated/promoted
